4c8818613437: Automated scan with axe-core 4.11 (WCAG 2.1 A and AA rules), scoped to the MultiDatePick component on a Lightning record page so Salesforce's own page chrome is excluded. Eight surfaces scanned: the Date, Date Time and Booking components, and the Calendar, Timeline, Week, Utilization and Agenda views. Code review of ARIA roles, names and keyboard handling, including the Setup Wizard. Color contrast is covered under 1.4.3.
bac76771f92d: This report covers the MultiDatePick components themselves: the Date, Date Time and Booking components, the five calendar views of the Booking component, and the Setup Wizard. The surrounding Salesforce platform (Lightning chrome, navigation bar, record header, related lists, App Launcher) is the responsibility of Salesforce and is governed by Salesforce's own VPAT, available at <t1>salesforce.com/company/legal/accessibility</t1>.
70b08714e13b: Buying for a public agency? Read <t1>our Section 508 guide for government teams</t1>.
da4bfbe9fa4f: axe-core 4.11, WCAG 2.1 A and AA rules, run October 21, 2026 against managed package 0.12.0-4 and the unpackaged source, and again October 26, 2026 against the unpackaged source with the 0.13.0 additions. All three runs returned the same result.
d4b94902a3c6: axe flags two checks for manual review on every surface. It cannot follow ARIA id references inside Lightning's shadow DOM; code review confirms each referenced id exists in the same component. It also returns no automated contrast result inside the component; contrast is covered under 1.4.3 below.
1f8046663abf: Conformance Level values in this report use the following terms (per the ITI VPAT 2.5 template):
97e821b818f1: <t1>Supports</t1>: the functionality of the product has at least one method that meets the criterion without known defects or meets with equivalent facilitation.
15f4b312a643: <t1>Partially Supports</t1>: some functionality of the product does not meet the criterion.
60be957e7c9b: <t1>Does Not Support</t1>: the majority of product functionality does not meet the criterion.
470173ae8672: <t1>Not Applicable</t1>: the criterion is not relevant to the product.
b922b421020b: All interactive icon-only buttons (calendar prev/next, day cells, time slots, status pills) expose accessible names via <t1>aria-label</t1> or <t2>title</t2>. Day cells include full date + state in the accessible name (e.g., "Wednesday, April 1, 2026, selected, today").
87f0e7a5c86f: Calendar markup uses semantic ARIA grid: <t1>role="grid"</t1> → <t2>role="row"</t2> → <t3>role="gridcell"</t3> + <t4>role="columnheader"</t4>. Form labels are programmatically associated via <t5>lightning-input</t5> / <t6>lightning-textarea</t6>. Status pill groups use <t7>role="group"</t7>.
16c926e068c3: DOM order matches visual reading order. Wizard steps render in numbered order; calendar weeks render top-to-bottom; time slots render in time order.
af684c96dcc9: Instructions never rely solely on color, shape, or position. Status colors are paired with text labels in the status pill row.
0388521dc07a: Selected dates show both a colored fill AND a bold border ring. Conflicting time slots show diagonal stripes AND a status badge.
67d91b8366bd: All interactive elements keyboard-reachable. Arrow keys navigate the day grid; Tab moves between calendar / status pills / time grid; Enter / Space activates the focused cell; Escape closes modals. The month and year arrows are native buttons in the Tab order (0.13.0). In the five views, the view switcher, every booking bar, block, heatmap cell and agenda row is a native button with an accessible name.
f1ceeafaa2ee: Focus can leave every component via Tab or Escape. Modal-style screens (Import/Export, Save Configuration) can be closed with Escape.
4c319aa24eb2: No single-character shortcuts that could conflict with assistive technology. Arrow keys / Enter / Escape are scoped to the focused calendar grid only.
7e3f20b5ed06: No time limits are imposed on user interaction. CMT deploy polling shows progress without a user time limit.
6e9af97c65fa: No moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating content. Hover popovers appear on demand and disappear when the pointer leaves.
6d8da223eb9b: No flashing content. Deploy-in-progress spinner rotates slowly below the flash threshold.
9073894ef2c3: The product is a component, not a full page; bypass blocks are handled by Salesforce's Skip Navigation links.
19cd866fcc63: Page titles are set by the Salesforce platform, not the component.
fbb2fb687668: Tab order follows logical DOM order: heading → calendar grid → status pills (if shown) → time slot grid (if shown) → footer buttons.
035851c56cf2: Wizard links ("Take the guided tour first", "Component Deep Dives: Dates · DateTime · Booking") have descriptive text. The hover popover's "View Record" link is contextually clear.
abc6a6564731: Honors the user's Salesforce Locale. Built-in translations for 9 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese.
54d74a3c6c3d: Focusing a day cell, status pill, or time slot does not initiate a change of context. Selection occurs only on explicit click / Enter / Space.
f36b9a7f2735: Changing a form field value does not auto-submit. Explicit "Next" / "Save" / "Book" buttons trigger submission.
3a6669d842cc: Form errors (invalid date, conflict, FLS) surface in toast notifications and inline error text with <t1>role="alert"</t1> for screen reader announcement. Errors name the field, object or rule involved: a validation rule shows its own message, and a missing permission names what is missing.
ffd217d046b8: Every form field has a programmatically-associated label. Inline instructional text accompanies multi-step actions.
b67d36ed6b42: HTML markup is well-formed; validated via LWC compiler at build time. (Obsoleted in WCAG 2.2.)
3b084b607135: All interactive elements expose accessible name, role, and value. Calendar uses ARIA grid pattern with <t1>aria-selected</t1> on cells. Form inputs use semantic <t2>lightning-input</t2> / <t3>lightning-textarea</t3> / <t4>lightning-combobox</t4> components. The view switcher is a labeled button group with <t5>aria-pressed</t5> on the active view, and its view names and label follow the user's language. Each month and year arrow is a button named for its action ("Previous month", "Next month"). A calendar day that cannot be picked is announced as unavailable and carries <t6>aria-disabled</t6>. The Add to Calendar control is a real download link with a visible name. axe-core finds zero violations on all eight surfaces (see Scan Results).
6ed621058348: The product's CSS layout adapts to both portrait and landscape. No orientation lock.
f8bf4e06511e: Form fields map to identified input purposes via <t1>lightning-input</t1> attributes. Date fields use <t2>type="date"</t2>, time fields use <t3>type="time"</t3>.
4e88037e3d7c: Default colors meet 4.5:1 contrast against background. <t1>Status colors are chosen by the admin.</t1> A pale fill on a white background can fall below 4.5:1, and the product cannot prevent that choice. Use the SLDS color palette to stay compliant. The automated scan returns no contrast result inside the component, so this rating rests on review of the default palette.
95c1413b2c92: Text resizes up to 200% via browser zoom without loss of content or functionality.
cb74c0945596: All text is rendered as real text. No images of text are used in the UI.
ee9598ebfd22: Calendar grid and time slot grid reflow at common breakpoints. At 320 CSS pixels wide, the day grid maintains its 7-column structure (cells narrow proportionally rather than dropping to a vertical stack). The wizard's two-card path picker stacks vertically below 640px. Timeline, Week and Utilization are two-dimensional grids; in a narrow container they scroll horizontally inside a keyboard-focusable region. Agenda is a single column and reflows.
41baca91d319: Interactive component states (focus ring, hover, selected) use border or fill colors with at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.
6b665bb06b7a: User-applied text spacing overrides do not cause content loss. Text containers do not have fixed heights that would clip content.
8ad042df0e7f: The booking hover popover is dismissible (pointer leaves, Escape closes), hoverable, and persistent (does not auto-dismiss while focused).
155ebd117552: The product is a component, not a website with multiple pages.
a4da31a59285: Setup Wizard step and tab labels are descriptive ("Where it lives", "Shape", "Jump start", "Review"; "Closed days", "Hover card").
0c0bdab89707: All interactive elements show a visible focus indicator (blue ring on cells, orange outline on selected dates, SLDS button focus states).
c64bd1a8c654: Drag-to-select, and dragging a booking in Timeline or Week, are conveniences; click and the record's edit form are always the equivalent. No path-based or multi-point gestures required.
6c664e8411cd: Click-up (rather than click-down) finalizes selection. Pointer can be dragged off a control before release to cancel.
880b02c79f58: Visible button labels match their accessible names ("Save Dates", "Book", "Edit Bookings").
bc0ce2264799: The product does not respond to device motion.
94b21306788b: Translated labels respect the user's Salesforce Locale. No mixed-language content within a single screen.
7651e943c1d1: Wizard step navigation (Next / Back) is consistent across all paths. Footer button row is consistent across components.
b93cada3ad88: Calendar prev/next chevrons, status pill colors, capacity badges, and time slot icons are consistent across components.
b1ed82ec9617: Validation errors say what to fix. A bad config import, for example, reads "Invalid JSON. Please check the format and try again." A save inside the booking window's notice period names the dates and says to remove them or pick a later time.
86de5cb68628: Destructive actions (Delete Booking) use a two-click confirm pattern. Saves are additive by default. Removed dates are never deleted without an explicit Edit Mode delete.
7492640cda95: Status messages use <t1>role="alert"</t1>, <t2>role="status"</t2>, or Salesforce's <t3>ShowToastEvent</t3>, announced by screen readers without focus change. The Add to Calendar offer after a save and the license notice are <t4>role="status"</t4> regions.
7bc03a911d75: Section 508 references WCAG 2.0 Levels A and AA for software. WCAG 2.0 criteria are a subset of the WCAG 2.1 criteria reported above; see the WCAG tables for each applicable criterion.
a34dfd821f79: Fully usable with a screen reader. ARIA roles and labels announce calendar structure, status, and interaction state.
9b0dcf188ab6: Supports browser zoom to 200% (WCAG 1.4.4) and user-adjusted text spacing (1.4.12).
f4d038ed3911: Color is never the sole indicator of state. Selected dates have a bold border; conflicts have diagonal stripes; status pills include text labels.
d8337e97753e: The product does not require speech input.
25324b1a4900: Fully usable with single-pointer or keyboard-only input. No multi-touch gestures required.
6a325fc2827b: Click targets meet 24×24 CSS pixel minimum on the day grid. Time slots in dense capacity mode are smaller, a density setting the admin chooses.

e12d30c596c0: Honors browser and OS accessibility features (zoom, high-contrast mode, reduced motion).
